resources.string: Status: Running — location is being mocked
This app is not set as the mock location app. Go to Developer Options → Select mock location app → choose Fake GPS, then press Start again.

One-time setup:
1. Enable Developer Options: Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times.
2. Developer Options → Select mock location app → choose Fake GPS.

Then enter latitude / longitude below and press Start. Open Google Maps to verify.
